IA No. 2 of 2021
In 
WPSS No. 1069 of 2021 
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Amar Murti Shukla, Advocate, for the 
petitioners. 
Mr. N.S. Pundir, Deputy Advocate General
assisted by Mr. Hargovind Pant, Brief Holder for 
the State of Uttarakhand. 
IA No. 2 of 2021, filed by the petitioners, 
alongwith the rejoinder affidavit to the counter of 
respondent No.2, would stand allowed. 
The rejoinder affidavit is taken on record. 
The principal employer of the petitioner is 
respondent Nos. 3 and 4. 
Looking to the nature of relief sought by the 
petitioners in the present Writ Petition, for the grant 
of service benefits, including seniority, ACP and 
promotional pay scale, if at all, it is to be 
determined, it would be having a bearing on 
respondent Nos. 3 and 4. Hence, respondent Nos. 
3 and 4 are required to be heard. 
Let notice be issued to respondent Nos. 3 and 
4. 
The petitioners would take steps within a 
period of one week from today. 
The respondents may file their counter 
affidavit within a period of three weeks thereafter. 
Similarly, the respondent Nos. 1 and 5, if so 
advised, may also file their respective counter 
affidavit within the aforesaid period. 
List after the expiry of the aforesaid period of 
three weeks. 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
Dated 01.12.2021
Shiv
